list.text: The breeze here is perfect after crossing that valley.
The Vileplume spores don’t drift this far, you can breathe again.
Wait! Before you go, let me update your Pokédex.
\PN Pokédex was updated with the Orange Islands mode.
Professor Ivy wants as much field data as possible.
We can only study so many Pokémon inside the lab, we need Trainers to record the rest.
While you travel in the Islands, document every encounter. Even a single entry can change our research.
That’s all. Good luck out there! We’ll be waiting for your findings.
If you made it through the Vileplume Valley without fainting, then you must be tough…
But I’m not backing down, battle me!
I’m going to train on this beach every day until I become a solid Trainer.
